description: Cancel an open pickup order from the pickup monitor. It leaves the board and its stock reservation is released. Unless sparkOnly=true, it is also canceled in Shopify (refund and restock, when order updates push to Shopify) and the customer gets the sales-order canceled notification if that notification is on. sparkOnly=true only clears it from Spark. Completed and canceled orders cannot be canceled. Automation rules on order cancels apply. Requires Write + pickup.execute; operator credentials only. Preview first, then repeat identical arguments with previewReceipt and idempotencyKey. In-app assistants get a confirm card.

order.description: Pickup order id, order number or pickup code.

sparkOnly.description: true cancels only in Spark: Shopify is left as is and the customer is not told.

name: cancel_pickup_order
title: Cancel Pickup Order
